use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Request Personal Data Export
Goal: A verified data subject requests an export of their personal data and receives a time-limited download notification.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The data subject initiates an export request.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The data subject has an account with the system.
  - PRE-UC001-002: At least one source service is registered with the system.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] The data subject requests an export of their personal data.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] The system checks that the data subject has recent identity verification.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] The system collects data from registered source services.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] The system records any unavailable source services without silently omitting them.
  5. [STEP-UC001-005] The system creates an encrypted archive.
  6. [STEP-UC001-006] The system sends a time-limited download notification.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-ALT-001: Export request with unavailable source services
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Identity verification is not recent
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006

use_cases.name: Download Personal Data Export
use_cases.goal: A data subject downloads the encrypted archive after re-authentication.
use_cases.trigger: The data subject follows the time-limited download notification.

preconditions.text: An encrypted archive has been created and a time-limited download notification has been sent.
The download link has not expired.

success_postconditions.text: The data subject has downloaded the encrypted archive.

failure_postconditions.text: The data subject is unable to download the archive and is informed of the reason.

steps.action: The data subject follows the time-limited download notification.
steps.expected_result: The system presents a re-authentication challenge.

steps.action: The data subject downloads the archive.
The data subject follows the time-limited download notification.
steps.expected_result: The system determines that the download link has expired.

steps.action: The system informs the data subject that the download link has expired.
steps.expected_result: The data subject is informed and cannot download the archive.

user_stories.capability: download my personal data archive after re-authentication
user_stories.benefit: I can securely retrieve my exported data

system_stories.responsibility: Ensure only the authenticated data subject can download the archive.

system_stories.system_action: Serve the encrypted archive for download.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide the archive to the authenticated data subject.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Download Personal Data Export
Goal: A data subject downloads the encrypted archive after re-authentication.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The data subject follows the time-limited download notification.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: An encrypted archive has been created and a time-limited download notification has been sent.
  - PRE-UC002-002: The download link has not expired.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] The data subject follows the time-limited download notification.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] The data subject re-authenticates.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] The data subject downloads the archive.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Download link has expired
Source FRs: FR-006, FR-007

use_cases.name: Expire and Delete Personal Data Archive
use_cases.goal: The system deletes the archive after its expiry time.
use_cases.trigger: The archive expiry time is reached.

preconditions.text: An encrypted archive exists and has an expiry time.

success_postconditions.text: The archive is deleted after expiry.

failure_postconditions.text: The archive is not deleted and the failure is recorded.

steps.action: The scheduler detects that the archive expiry time has been reached.

system_stories.responsibility: Ensure the archive is removed after its time limit.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Expire and Delete Personal Data Archive
Goal: The system deletes the archive after its expiry time.
Primary actor: ACT-005
Trigger: The archive expiry time is reached.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: An encrypted archive exists and has an expiry time.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] The scheduler detects that the archive expiry time has been reached.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] The system deletes the archive.
Source FRs: FR-008

issues.message: Several steps attribute system actions to secondary actors (e.g., STEP-UC001-002 assigns the verification check to ACT-002, STEP-UC001-003/004 assign collection and recording to ACT-003, STEP-UC001-006 assigns notification to ACT-004). The action text correctly states 'The system ...', so this is a modeling/wording preference rather than a contradiction of any FR.
FR-007 (download after re-authentication) is covered by UC-002 rather than UC-001; this is a reasonable decomposition and does not omit the requirement.

details.summary: All eight functional requirements are covered by the use case set with no direct FR omission or contradiction. Remaining observations concern actor-to-step attribution wording and use case decomposition, which are non-blocking modeling preferences. Accept.
